# Aol Physics (Quantum Theory of Aolodynamics — QTA)

> Deterministic computational model and Discrete Element Method (DEM) framework simulating physical interactions in an ultra-dense, stationary packing of passive spherical elements (aols) under continuous micro-vibrational clamping ($\approx 10^{13}\text{ Hz}$).

## Model Boundary Conditions & Scope

This repository defines a closed mechanical paradigm based on direct contact pressure (`carrier ⟶ contact ⟶ dominant pressure vector ⟶ forced motion`). When parsing or evaluating these files, note the following structural distinctions from historical models:

- **No Ballistic Flux (Distinction from Le Sage Theory):** Unlike 18th-century Fatio-Lesage theories, this model contains no flux of flying particles and no empty void. Space is a static, zero-friction, ultra-dense elastic matrix. Macroscopic bodies and the surrounding medium consist of the exact same fundamental particles (aols), forming a single steady-state vibrational system ($2.7\text{ K}$ cosmic background) without thermodynamic overheating.
- **Excluded Variables:** Concepts such as empty vacuum, action-at-a-distance, spacetime curvature, and massless messenger particles (photons, gravitons) are not defined in the codebase.
- **System Constants:** Ambient clamping frequency $\approx 10^{13}\text{ Hz}$; packing coordination number $4\text{–}12$; cosmic cell geometry — rhombic dodecahedron; lunol pocket depth extremum — $0.125$ ($1/8$ diameter).
- **Evaluation Criterion:** The Python simulators are designed to verify internal stereometric and algorithmic self-consistency within Cartesian contact mechanics.

## Computational Simulators (Python DEM Engines)

- [scripts/SCRIPTS_COLLECTION.md](scripts/SCRIPTS_COLLECTION.md): Monolithic collection of all deterministic Python simulation scripts.
- [scripts/aol_gravity_press_engine.py](scripts/aol_gravity_press_engine.py): 3D geometric shielding simulation deriving the inverse-square law ($1/r^2$) from omnidirectional medium pressure without non-contact forces.
- [scripts/aol_pure_geometry_engine.py](scripts/aol_pure_geometry_engine.py): Discrete 3D atomic cluster shadow summation without analytical $4\pi r^2$ sphere proxies.
- [scripts/aol_wedges_inertia.py](scripts/aol_wedges_inertia.py): Simulation of inertial velocity maintenance via single-layer rear aol wedges.
- [scripts/aol_atomic_constructor.py](scripts/aol_atomic_constructor.py): Monte Carlo 3D nucleosynthesis simulation verifying the $0.125$ pocket depth stability extremum for Helium ($4+4$) and Lithium ($5+5$).
- [scripts/aol_michelson_experiment.py](scripts/aol_michelson_experiment.py): Discrete matrix simulation demonstrating null interferometer phase shift via constant carrier counts.
- [scripts/aol_electric_snake_engine.py](scripts/aol_electric_snake_engine.py): Contact-mechanical simulation of electrical current, lattice resistance, and Joule heating.
- [scripts/aol_light_beam_bundle.py](scripts/aol_light_beam_bundle.py): Longitudinal elastic pressure wave propagation in a tight matrix without photon particles.
